sellerReview.readiness.ready: The evidence approval needs is in place
sellerReview.readiness.readyBody: Every required step is finished, every required document is accepted and in date, and the screening this marketplace requires is clear. Approving is still your decision.
sellerReview.readiness.blocked: Approving is refused until each of these is in place:
sellerReview.readiness.STEP_INCOMPLETE: A required step of the application is not finished
sellerReview.readiness.DOCUMENT_NOT_APPR: A required document has not been accepted
sellerReview.readiness.SCREENING_NOT_CLE: The screening of {{name}} is not clear

sellerReview.kyb.outstanding: The seller has still to give

sellerReview.screening.manualBody: No automated screening provider is connected. Check the lists yourself, then record which lists you checked and what you found. Each result is saved as a manual check under your name.
sellerReview.screening.notRequired: This marketplace does not require screening before approval.
sellerReview.screening.noOwners: The seller has not listed anybody who owns or controls the business.
sellerReview.screening.pepDeclared: Declared by the seller as a politically exposed person

sellerReview.turnover.description: This marketplace’s eligibility policy {{version}}: turnover for the most recently completed financial year must be at least {{minimum}}. Verifying it does not approve the seller.
sellerReview.turnover.loadFailed: The turnover declaration could not be loaded.
sellerReview.turnover.grandfathered: This seller was approved before the turnover policy applied, so it is not asked for a declaration and approval is not held for one.
sellerReview.turnover.policyOff: The turnover policy is switched off on this deployment.
sellerReview.turnover.noEvidence: The seller has not uploaded any supporting document.

sellerReview.readiness.TURNOVER_NOT_VERI: The declared turnover has not been verified
sellerVerification.title: Seller verification
sellerVerification.description: Seller applications waiting for the Audit Team. Check the business, its documents, turnover and owners, then decide. Oldest first.
sellerVerification.resubmittedHint: These sellers sent their application back after the Audit Team asked for corrections. Check what changed first.
sellerVerification.empty.review: Nobody has an application in review.
sellerVerification.empty.corrections: No application is waiting for corrections from a seller.
sellerVerification.empty.resubmitted: No corrected application has come back yet.
sellerVerification.empty.approved: No seller has been approved yet.
sellerVerification.empty.all: There are no seller applications yet.
sellerVerification.explain.UNDER_REVIEW: Mark the application as in review, so the seller and the team know somebody is working on it.
sellerVerification.explain.ACTION_REQUIR: Send the application back to the seller. Say exactly what to correct; the seller reads this.
sellerVerification.explain.APPROVED: Approve the seller. Approval is refused while required steps, documents, screenings or turnover are still missing.
sellerVerification.explain.REJECTED: Reject the application. Say why; the seller reads this.
sellerVerification.allowResubmissionHint: Leave this on unless the business should not apply again. It can only be reopened while it is on.
sellerVerification.reasonRequired: Write the reason the seller will read.
sellerVerification.notReadyTitle: Approval is still waiting for evidence
sellerVerification.notReadyBody: {{gaps}} item(s) are still missing. The list is in the approval panel below.
sellerVerification.draftBody: The seller is still filling in their application. There is nothing to decide until they submit it.
sellerVerification.suspendedBody: A suspension is lifted in the Admin Panel. The Audit Team can still ask for corrections or reject the application.
sellerVerification.businessHint: As the seller submitted them. The Audit Team does not change these; ask for corrections instead.
sellerVerification.documentsHint: The certificates and licences the seller uploaded. Open each one, then accept or refuse it.
sellerVerification.noDocuments: The seller has not uploaded any documents.
sellerVerification.refuseHint: Say what is wrong with the document. The seller reads this.
sellerVerification.documentRefused: Document refused. The seller has been told why.
sellerVerification.historyHint: Every decision on this application and who made it. Decisions made in the Admin Panel before the Audit Team took over still show the administrator.
shipmentAssessment.title: Shipment assessment
shipmentAssessment.description: Shipments that have finished L1 and are waiting for L2. Assess them, or decide a badge-based waiver. Nothing leaves the port of loading without a release.
shipmentAssessment.rolloutHint: These shipments were already waiting for L2 when shipment assessment was switched on. None of them has been waived. Review each one like a new shipment.
shipmentAssessment.searchPlaceholder: Assessment, order, seller order or seller
shipmentAssessment.refusal.L1_NOT_COMPLE: L1 has not been handed over at the port or airport of loading yet.
shipmentAssessment.refusal.NOT_APPROVED: L2 cannot start: the shipment has not been released.
shipmentAssessment.refusal.NO_AUTHORIZAT: L2 cannot start: there is no active release.
shipmentAssessment.refusal.AUTHORIZATION: The release passed its dispatch deadline. The shipment must be reviewed again.
shipmentAssessment.refusal.SHIPMENT_CHAN: The shipment changed after release. It must be reviewed again.
shipmentAssessment.refusal.BADGE_CHANGED: The seller's badge changed after the waiver. The waiver no longer applies.
shipmentAssessment.refusal.LOADING_CHECK: Released, but L2 waits for the final loading checks to pass.
shipmentAssessment.waiverExplain: The badge only makes this shipment eligible. You decide. Look at the history below, then approve the waiver or require a physical assessment. A waiver never removes the final loading checks.
shipmentAssessment.historyUnavailable: The seller history could not be read. Leave the decision pending or require an assessment.
shipmentAssessment.historyReviewHint: Required for Gold. Say what you looked at and what you concluded.
shipmentAssessment.deadlineHint: Leave empty only when the policy has an approved window.
shipmentAssessment.independence: You assessed this shipment. Another person must do the QA review.
shipmentAssessment.holdOrReassess: Hold the shipment or require reassessment
shipmentAssessment.noRound: No assessment round has started yet.
shipmentAssessment.checklistIntro: Checklist {{version}}, round {{round}}. Every check has its own result. A correct quantity does not make up for bad packaging or a wrong label.
shipmentAssessment.section.I: I. Shelf life and sensitive goods
shipmentAssessment.section.J: J. Condition on arrival from L1
shipmentAssessment.quantitiesHint: Record each figure separately. The approved quantity must be the whole order: there is no partial release.
shipmentAssessment.submitHint: A fail or a hold blocks the whole shipment and issues a findings report. A pass goes to QA.
shipmentAssessment.detail.NA_REASON_REQU: say why it does not apply
shipmentAssessment.detail.APPROVED_NOT_W: the approved quantity must be the whole order
shipmentAssessment.detail.COUNT_REQUIRED: enter the counted and approved quantities
shipmentAssessment.detail.SAMPLE_ABOVE_C: the sample is larger than the count
shipmentAssessment.sampledNotice: Results come from a sample of {{sampled}} of {{counted}} units. The other units were counted, not examined one by one.
shipmentAssessment.event.CREATED_AT_ROLL: Case opened for an existing shipment
shipmentAssessment.documentsHint: Issued documents are never changed. A correction is a new version. A shipment document stays as evidence after dispatch and cannot release anything again.
shipmentAssessment.policy.title: Badge policy
shipmentAssessment.policy.description: Which Audit badge may be offered a waiver, and the limits on dispatch deadlines and certificates. Every version is kept.
shipmentAssessment.policy.defaultHint: Leave empty when there is no approved window. Reviewers then set and justify each deadline.
shipmentAssessment.policy.reviewerSets: None - the reviewer sets and justifies each deadline
shipmentAssessment.policy.notLegal: These periods are platform policy. They are not legal or ISO requirements.
shipmentAssessment.policy.readOnly: Only an Audit supervisor can change the policy.
shipmentAssessment.badgePanel.title: Audit badge and certificates
shipmentAssessment.badgePanel.descriptio: The badge only decides whether a shipment may be offered a waiver. An auditor still decides each one. The seller cannot choose or change it.
shipmentAssessment.certificates.title: Seller verification certificates
shipmentAssessment.certificates.needsApp: A certificate can be issued after the final verification approval.
sa.problem.TURNOVER_CURRENCY: Turnover must be stated in Indian rupees.
sa.problem.TURNOVER_MEASURE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only the applicant company’s revenue from operations, excluding GST, counts. Group turnover, forecasts and unaudited sales do not.
sa.problem.CA_CONFIRMATION_MISSING: The chartered accountant’s confirmation is missing.
sa.problem.PRECEDING_AUDIT_MISSING: The previous year’s audited statements are missing.
sa.problem.APPLICANT_TYPE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Only Indian manufacturers and Indian brand owners are eligible.
sa.problem.NOT_INDIAN_ENTITY: The applicant must be an Indian legal entity.
sa.problem.ADDRESSES_INCOMPLETE: Registered and operating addresses are incomplete.
sa.problem.DELEGATION_MISSING: Upload the signatory’s delegation of authority.
sa.problem.BANK_MISSING: Bank beneficiary details and evidence are required.
sa.problem.BRAND_RIGHTS_MISSING: Upload proof of trademark ownership or brand rights.
sa.problem.FACILITY_OUTSIDE_INDIA: Facilities outside India are not accepted under this policy.
sa.problem.FOREIGN_SUBCONTRACTING: Foreign subcontracting is not accepted under this policy.
sa.problem.AGREEMENTS_MISSING: Upload the manufacturing and quality agreements for facilities you do not own.
sa.problem.AUDIT_ACCESS_NOT_GRANTED: Agree to audit access for every facility.
sa.problem.PRODUCTS_MISSING: Add the products you want to sell.
sa.problem.PRODUCT_FOREIGN_MADE: Foreign-made finished goods are not accepted under this policy.
sa.problem.PRODUCT_SCOPE_INCOMPLETE: Each product needs a facility, destination countries and channels.
sa.problem.CONSENT_MISSING: Agree to the identity and screening checks.
sa.title: Seller assessment
sa.detail.policyDraft: Policy {{version}} is a draft. Its proposed commercial defaults are not in force until adoption, an effective date and disclosure are recorded. A production deployment refuses binding decisions under a draft.
sa.detail.hardStops: Hard stops recorded - release is blocked whatever the score
sa.detail.softwareNotAssessment: This screen records the assessment. A record here is not proof that a site visit, a bank check, a laboratory test or an external certification really took place - the evidence is.
sa.overview.serviceTarget: service target, not a promise of approval
sa.overview.rawApplication: Show every answer the seller gave
sa.gate1.title: Gate 1: the application file
sa.gate1.description: Accept a complete file to start the review, or return it with the corrections the seller must make. A returned file gives no trading access.
sa.gateDecision.title: Record a gate decision
sa.gateDecision.description: Gates 2 to 7. The server checks your capability, the gate’s prerequisites and its own evidence before it accepts a pass.
sa.assign.title: Ownership and risk
sa.assign.description: The Head of Seller Assurance names the owner and the risk level.
sa.assign.ownerHint: An active Audit staff member. Leave empty for none.
sa.evidence.title: Evidence
sa.evidence.description: Private files. Each replacement is a new version; earlier versions stay with the decisions that used them.
sa.evidence.keyHint: A short name, for example site-photos or lab-report.
sa.checklist.title: Applicant checklist (23 items)
sa.checklist.description: Untouched items stay unreviewed. Not applicable needs a reason and a second person’s approval, and is never allowed for a mandatory item.
sa.checklist.mandatory: Mandatory: cannot be marked not applicable.
sa.score.thresholds: Release needs at least {{release}} and every dimension at least {{dimension}} of 5. {{remediation}} to below {{release}} means remediation; below {{remediation}} is declined.
sa.score.hardStopsOverride: A hard stop is recorded. It overrides any score.
sa.score.notCertification: The score is an internal management tool. It is not an industry certification standard and it never replaces a hard gate.
sa.score.caption: Score by dimension
sa.band.RELEASE_ELIGIBLE: Eligible for release if everything else passes
sa.dimensionEvidence.IDENTITY: Valid legal entity, beneficial ownership and turnover
sa.dimensionEvidence.PRODUCT_DESTINATION: Regulatory evidence for the exact SKU and market
sa.dimensionEvidence.MANUFACTURING_QUALI: Site audit, process control and traceability
sa.dimensionEvidence.SAMPLE_TESTING: Controlled samples and competent laboratory results
sa.dimensionEvidence.FULFILMENT_SERVICE: Capacity, stock, packaging, logistics and support
sa.dimensionEvidence.INTEGRITY_CAPA: Authentic records, references and effective closure
sa.scope.noRegions: Each row is one product version, one site, one country and one channel. There is no regional approval: a European Union country, the UK, an EEA country, Switzerland and the USA each need their own row.
sa.scope.caption: Product, site, country and channel scope
sa.scope.classifyHint: Gate 3 needs the Regulatory Compliance capability. A template from another country may help you; it never clears this one.
sa.findings.deadlines: Critical: contain immediately, release blocked. Major: action plan within 7 days, verified closure within 30, release blocked until closed. Minor: closure within 60 days. A deadline never allows unsafe supply.
sa.findings.blocks: Release is blocked until an auditor closes this finding.
sa.workpapers.title: Workpapers
sa.workpapers.description: Records of the work people did. A correction is a new revision; nothing is overwritten.
sa.workpapers.honest: Record only what really happened. A simulated step stays marked as simulated.
sa.workpapers.mockHint: Provider-verified only when that integration is switched on here.
sa.workpapers.aiLimits: AI output is advice for a reviewer: extraction, consistency checks, expiry, research flags or a draft workpaper. It never approves a seller, issues a certificate, resolves a sanctions match, decides legal compliance or moves money. Do not put confidential documents into a public AI service.
sa.wp.subject: Subject
sa.cert.independence: The marketplace appoints and pays the independent body. A seller cannot choose or replace it, and a seller’s upload never proves a certificate is genuine. The body is never shown as authorised beyond its verified scope.
sa.cert.appointHint: Reuse the purchase order and payment references from procurement where there are any.
sa.cert.covers: Covers sites {{facilities}} and {{products}} product versions in this assessment.
sa.cert.accreditationConfirmed: I verified the accreditation and sector scope
sa.cert.recordAuthenticated: Record as authenticated with the issuer
sa.release.noGaps: Nothing blocks release. An independent approver may now release the exact scope below.
sa.release.independence: The release approver must hold the release capability and must not have taken part in this assessment in any role.
sa.release.title: Gate 8: independent release
sa.release.exactScope: Only the rows ticked become purchasable. Pending extensions stay blocked.
sa.release.done: Released. The trading approval is issued.
sa.approval.notExternal: This is the marketplace’s internal approval. It is not the external certificate and not a government or accreditation approval.
sa.suspend.title: Suspend, restrict or revoke
sa.suspend.shareableEvidence: Evidence that can lawfully be shared
sa.suspend.riskContainmentNote: Risk containment for scope kept active
sa.suspend.whole: No rows selected: the whole approval is suspended.
sa.suspend.partial: {{rows}} rows selected: the rest stays active only with the risk-containment note.
sa.timeline.title: Decision timeline
sa.timeline.description: Append-only: who did what, with which capability, why, under which policy, on which evidence version.
sa.queue.description: Every seller assessment across the eight gates.
sa.queue.emptyHint: Try another status or clear the filters.
sa.assurance.title: Seller assurance
sa.assurance.description: Policy, capabilities, activation impact, registers, held orders, surveillance and retention across every seller.
sa.policy.inForce: Policy {{version}} is adopted, disclosed and in force.
sa.policy.draftOnly: No adopted policy is in force. Version {{version}} is a draft: its proposed defaults do not bind anybody yet.
sa.policy.gateMode: Purchase gate mode: {{mode}}. Off changes nothing; report logs what would be blocked; enforce blocks.
sa.policy.commercialVsMandatory: These are configurable commercial defaults. Hard gates, hard stops, current independent certification, exact scope and independent release are mandatory controls that no version or exception can relax.
sa.capabilities.title: Assessment capabilities
sa.capabilities.description: Granted by the Head of Seller Assurance, never to yourself. One person may hold several, and independence is still checked against what they did on each assessment.
sa.impact.summary: Gate mode {{mode}}. If enforced now, {{blocked}} of {{offers}} live offers from {{sellers}} sellers would stop being purchasable.
sa.impact.note: Coverage is per offer. Each offer is then purchasable only for the exact countries and channels in its approved scope.
sa.impact.legacy: Sellers approved under the earlier process
sa.impact.legacyHint: Opens a reassessment for each. Their earlier approval stays in their history; nothing is converted into a trading approval.
sa.impact.caption: Activation impact by seller
sa.registers.appealsHint: Decided by somebody who took no part in the original decision. An appeal never restores selling by itself.
sa.registers.bankHint: Confirm through a contact known independently of the request, then two different Finance approvers.
sa.dispositions.title: Placed orders held for a safety and legal disposition
sa.dispositions.description: Nothing ships, cancels or refunds by itself because a seller’s status changed. Record what happens to each order.
sa.surveillance.title: Surveillance and revalidation
sa.surveillance.description: Created each day: expiry reminders at 90, 60 and 30 days, monthly certificate and insurance checks, annual turnover and ownership revalidation, sanctions re-screening and category surveillance. Purchases never depend on this list - every date is checked on each request.
sa.retention.title: Retention and legal holds
sa.retention.description: General assessment records: the policy’s years after the last relevant transaction or the end of the relationship. Identity, EU DSA trader and US INFORM data follow their own rules; where a legal value is not configured, records are kept and the gap is shown here.

agreements.screen.introConsumer: To shop for yourself on {{marketplace}}, agree to the B2C Consumer Terms & Conditions and the B2C Platform Services Agreement, and confirm that you have read the Privacy Policy. Open each document to read it in full.
agreements.screen.consumerRightsNote: Agreeing does not give up your rights to cancel, return goods, claim under a guarantee, get a refund, complain or dispute a payment. It does not switch on marketing, cookies, recurring orders, AutoPay or any paid extra: each of those is a separate choice. Your existing orders, returns and claims stay open to you whatever you decide here.

productSafety.separationTitle: A different person must do this
productSafety.evidence.title: Product evidence
productSafety.evidence.description: Certificates, test reports, declarations and registrations for each product version, site and country. Verify each one with its issuer.
productSafety.evidence.empty: No product evidence matches these filters.
productSafety.evidence.changeStatusFor: Change the status of the evidence for {{product}}
productSafety.evidence.verifyHint: You cannot verify evidence that you recorded yourself. Check it with the issuer and write down how you checked it and what the check showed.
productSafety.evidence.expiryHint: Only an expiry the issuer or the law sets. Leave it empty if there is none.
productSafety.evidence.gapHint: Say what the accepted evidence does not cover and how the gap is closed.
productSafety.evidence.limitIntro: Each kind of evidence proves only what it names. The table shows what it does not prove.
productSafety.evidence.f.requiredHint: If this evidence is withdrawn, suspended or past its expiry, the product cannot be bought or dispatched in this country.
productSafety.evidence.f.method: How it was checked with the issuer
productSafety.matrix.title: Assurance matrix by department
productSafety.matrix.notice: These are prompts for the reviewer, not a list of what every product legally needs. The reviewer records the actual route, law, test method, issuer and dates for each product and country.
productSafety.cases.title: Safety cases
productSafety.cases.description: Product safety problems: contain them, trace who is affected, decide on reporting and recall, correct the cause and release.
productSafety.cases.col.title: Title
productSafety.scope.title: Scope
productSafety.rehearsal.title: Annual recall rehearsal
productSafety.rehearsal.none: No recall rehearsal has been recorded.
productSafety.rehearsal.due: A rehearsal is due: none was recorded in the last 12 months.
productSafety.detail.ordersStillManaged: While a case is contained, existing orders, returns and refunds can still be managed as usual.
productSafety.detail.containHint: Stop what is in scope from being sold, shipped or reordered while the case is open.
productSafety.trace.title: Trace
productSafety.trace.hint: Who and what this case reaches.
productSafety.actions.title: Actions
productSafety.actions.reportingHint: A reporting decision is made by a qualified person, never by AI. Name the authority, the decision and your qualified role.
productSafety.actions.qualifiedRole: Qualified role of the person deciding
productSafety.actions.qualifiedRoleHint: For example: regulatory affairs manager, responsible person.
productSafety.correction.title: Correction
productSafety.release.title: Release
productSafety.release.explain: Release needs the containment, root cause, correction evidence, verification tests and current certificates on file. It must be done by a different person from the one who opened the case.
productSafety.release.noPermission: You do not have permission to release safety cases.
